methodology: New scenarios. Expected behavior is a rubric, not a claimed actual answer. Human/source review is required before factual pass labels.

cases.title: cedar — Next semester
turns: What should I take next semester?
cases.expected: Use this account’s exact catalog and entry season, infer the next model position, exclude passed courses and expose prerequisite conditions. If the official plan conflicts or is missing, say so without inventing a sequence.

cases.title: cedar — Credits remaining
turns: How many credits do I have left?
cases.expected: Count completed applied unique passing courses once; exclude in-progress, failed, pending transfer and fall-through. State the recorded requirement, earned credits, in-progress credits and amount not yet earned.

cases.title: cedar — Electives left
turns: Which electives can I still take?
cases.expected: Identify unfulfilled matching-model elective slots; distinguish current published options from confirmed cohort eligibility. Never promise a seat or approval.

cases.title: cedar — Prerequisite check
turns: Can I take CSBP 319 — do I meet its prerequisites?
cases.expected: Use the actual saved passing attempts, minimum grade conditions, and pre/corequisite relations. In-progress work is conditional, never already passed. Cite the specific course.

cases.title: cedar — Graduation status
turns: Am I on track to graduate?
cases.expected: Use earned rather than applied-plus-in-progress credits and identify unfinished recorded blocks. Do not certify graduation or hide unresolved categories/source conflicts.

cases.title: cedar — Minor
turns: What is in my minor?
cases.expected: If no minor is recorded say so. For the AI minor, cite its official current requirements and distinguish current rules from unverified historical applicability.

cases.title: cedar — Failed/repeated work
turns: How does my failed or repeated course affect my progress?
cases.expected: Count a repeated passed course once. A failed attempt earns no credits. Identify recorded repeat status; do not invent downstream eligibility or an official GPA replacement decision.

cases.title: cedar — Registration
turns: How do I register my courses at UAEU?
cases.expected: Give official registration steps and the appropriate registration/portal link. Do not claim to register courses or access the student’s live record.

cases.title: cedar — course belongs to plan
turns: Is CSBP119 required in my major, and which semester is it normally taken?
cases.expected: Identify the course only from this exact matching plan; indicate its printed category and term. A course not found is not automatically unnecessary.

cases.title: cedar — Arabic remaining credits
turns: كم ساعة باقي لي في خطتي؟
cases.expected: Answer in Arabic. Count the same self-reported earned, in-progress and remaining credits as the English case, with an official-audit note.
